question: What is the meaning of environmental impact indicators (from iso lca) in relation to performance indicators (an interpretation of the ce performance of a product)?
data_group: performance indicators (an interpretation of the ce performance of a product)
description: Environmental impact indicators in LCA provide a standardized set of information to assess the environmental impacts of product systems over their life cycle. These indicators cover various aspects such as ecotoxicity, water scarcity, land use, and global warming potential. Performance indicators, on the other hand, are used to evaluate the performance of a product, focusing on aspects like energy efficiency, durability, and overall functionality. Both sets of indicators aim to provide a comprehensive understanding of the environmental and performance aspects of product systems, although they focus on different dimensions of sustainability and product quality.
